title: Pekka Poikanen (Peter Pan)
summary: "Pekka Poikanen (Peter Pan)" by J. M. Barrie is a work originating as a play in 1904 and a novel in 1911. It follows Peter Pan, a mischievous boy who can fly and never grows up, as he takes Wendy Darling and her brothers to Neverland—a magical island filled with mermaids, fairies, pirates, and the Lost Boys. Together they face adventures involving the jealous fairy Tinker Bell and the villainous Captain Hook, while Wendy becomes a mother figure to Peter's gang of lost children.
